NVDA.reason: Very strong AI growth, but expectations are extremely high after a huge market-cap run.

GOOGL.reason: Strong profits and AI/search leadership, with regulatory risk and high expectations.

AAPL.reason: Premium brand and cash flow, but growth must justify the large valuation.

MSFT.reason: Durable software/cloud business, but AI spending and valuation are important to watch.

AMZN.reason: AWS and ads support growth, while retail margins and valuation still matter.

AVGO.reason: AI infrastructure exposure is strong, but chip cycles and acquisition risk matter.

TSLA.reason: Investors price in future autonomy and growth, making expectations demanding.

META.reason: Large cash-generating ads business, but platform and AI spending risks remain.

MU.reason: Memory demand can be strong, but memory stocks are cyclical and can swing sharply.

BRK.B.reason: Diversified businesses and cash-heavy balance sheet can look steadier than high-growth tech.

LLY.reason: Major medicine growth is exciting, but the valuation depends on continued execution.
